title: Fixed Suspended Tubular Bell Frame
description: One newly authored complete fixed suspended tubular percussion-bell frame. Two grounded runners, braced portal columns and a full overhead crossbeam carry nine independently thick, genuinely open-ended tubes on rear hangers and captive transverse upper pins. A full rear damping-style rail has a dark contact face, side roots and a fixed link down to a pedal rooted on the right runner. Unlike the complete old windchest organ, these pipes hang from overhead without windchest, keyboard or mouth-cut feet. Unlike the complete old two-row bar-resonator frame, there are no bars above closed-bottom resonator cups: these full open-ended hanging tubes are the main exterior. All geometry independently authored; three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up, horizontal whole centering and finite ground soles. One model, zero scenes. Silent static illustration only, no tuning, audible output, playable percussion, working suspension or damping/pedal motion, load, fabrication, operation or safety claim.
